B2B materials developer, but known among fashion and outdoor brands.

Well-known aviation brand in the media, with strong public interest.

B2B engineering contractor with strong industry reputation and no consumer awareness.

Revenue is around $1.1 billion. Related to the Odfjell family business. B2B energy services company with no consumer brand awareness.
